confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Manila pricing for July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine are not directly known and are set relative to beer and restaurant pricing. The FX observation comes from search results attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page. I could not open the RBA F11 table to confirm it, so verify it on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian large-city pricing. Food and budget accommodation are set near Ho Chi Minh City and Jakarta. Three-star hotel pricing is set nearer the Bangkok mid-range tier, since Manila's business-district hotels are priced higher than its budget options.
